about: Sterlite Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. It operates through Optical Networking Business and Digital and Technology Solutions segments. The company designs and manufactures optical fibres, optical fibre cables and specialty cables, optical connectivity, and optical inter connect products.
